body: Yes. In order to delete a cookie from a browser one must send empty one in the same request `\yii::$app->response->cookies->has` gives you `true`. On the next request it should give you `false`.
Shouldn't hascookie then check for empty if empty means that it should be deleted?
@AShagovin @cebe should we set expire to null in loadCookies?
